messages:
Alex G: FYI onboarding ParcelPro's LoRA adapter. after int4 conversion some numbered bullet lists in shipment summaries are getting reordered (1/2/3 -> 2/1/3) which is bad for their packing checks. quick repro attached.
Nina P: that's odd. paste a minimal prompt that shows reorder?
Alex G: `Shipment summary:
1) 3x widget A
2) 1x widget B
3) 2x widget C
Please return as a JSON list ->` model sometimes returns items with 1 and 2 swapped.
Carlos M: is this only with int4? fp16 baseline ok?
Alex G: fp16 clean. int4 shows reorder in ~6% of runs on our small checklist. batching seems to increase frequency.
Ruth Y: could be quantized attention instability during relative-pos handling that affects ordering. first checks: tokenizer, seed, sampling, and whether list tokens (numbers, parens) quantize poorly.
Alex G: ran a narrow quickpack: `./evals/run_quickpack.sh --model parcelpro/lora --quant int4 --suite structure,list-order --batch 1,4 --ctx 2048 --dump-logits --dump-attn`
ci-bot: ci/parcelpro-int4-707 started by @Alex G (inference-eval:canary)
Alex G: logs excerpt: ```
[prompt] Shipment summary:
1) 3x widget A
2) 1x widget B
3) 2x widget C
->
[emit] [{"qty":1,"item":"widget B"},{"qty":3,"item":"widget A"},{"qty":2,"item":"widget C"}]
[reason] stop_reason: eos
[logits] last_layer_entropy: 0.24 -> 0.03 (failing)
```
Nina P: entropy collapse in last layer + low activations suggests quant scaling or clamp issue. try `--quant-backend=x64-fallback` and `--disable-fused-attn` to rule out kernel bug. also run greedy decode.
Carlos M: also check positional embedding folding when LoRA merged. if position-sensitive weights are folded into low-precision tensors, ranking of list tokens could flip. add `--dump-folded-weights` and compare per-position deltas.
Ruth Y: good idea. add `--seed=42` and deterministic decode so we can reproduce. also include `--dump-token-probs` to see if numeric tokens' probs cross over.
Alex G: kicked off debug runs with fallback kernels and deterministic seed. ci-bot: ci/parcelpro-int4-707 debug appended (artifacts uploading)
Alex G: uploaded traces: s3://redwood-evals/parcelpro/707/trace_bundle.tar.gz
Nina P: if confirmed clamp/scale bug, mitigation plan: 1) add a post-fold per-tensor calibration pass for position-sensitive tensors; 2) unit test: fold LoRA + quantize and assert list-order-preserved on a 50-case mini-suite; 3) runtime fallback: if `list-order-fidelity` drops >3% for tenant, route them to fp16 or safe-quant preset.
Carlos M: we should also add an Optimize rule flagging "enumerated lists" workloads as sensitive to aggressive quant, with recommended `--quant-preset=safe` for customers using many structured lists.
Ruth Y: I'll add an entry to the model rollout playbook (canary thresholds, metric name: list-order-fidelity, auto-fallback steps).
Alex G: thanks. will open PR for calibration patch after I confirm failing layer. will post PR & quickpack (customer-facing zip + notebook) to the support ticket once ready.
